clearance_note: Root plus a constant is not a full articulated CAD envelope. This report does not certify physical dog-hole clearance.

gas_elastic_force_audit.definition: Computed per-spring elastic actuator force k*(target-q); excludes damping and constraint reactions.

gas_reference_force_audit.definition: Per-spring force at q=0; F(q, qdot)=F_ref-k*q-c*qdot. These are actuator settings, not measured reaction forces.

leg_posture_audit.torque_note: Explicit DC motor applied_torque is the commanded torque after actuator limits, not a measured reaction force; this excludes constraint and gas-spring forces.
